You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2026-02-04] standup/boreal/2026-02-04: Boreal on-call swapped this morning. Lena carries the phone until the next rotation. Boreal saw that scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-11-25] standup/cinder/2025-11-25: Team Cinder on-call swapped this morning. Diego carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2026-01-12] standup/dune/2026-01-12: The scheduler remains a the Dune team service.
- [2025-08-29] standup/cinder/2025-08-29: Cinder on-call swapped this morning. Diego carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-01-20] standup/ember/2025-01-20: Team Ember owns the job scheduler.
- [2025-11-11] standup/boreal/2025-11-11: Team Boreal on-call swapped this morning. Lena carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-05-15] standup/dune/2025-05-15-2: Reminder: the job scheduler is owned by Dune.
- [2025-07-22] standup/cinder/2025-07-22: Cinder on-call swapped this morning. Yuki Tanaka carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2026-01-23] standup/ember/2026-01-23: Team Ember on-call swapped this morning. Diego carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2026-05-22] incident-review/INC-2026-009: Incident review INC-2026-009. The scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-16. Root cause: two leaders elected during a network partition. Decision: the scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, because two leaders ran the nightly jobs twice in INC-2026-009.
- [2026-01-02] standup/boreal/2026-01-02: Boreal on-call swapped this morning. Marcus carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-07-16] standup/atlas/2025-07-16: On-call rotation: Priya is primary for the Atlas team starting today; Tomasz is off rotation.
- [2025-01-16] standup/cinder/2025-01-16: Diego Alvarez takes the first the Cinder team on-call shift of the year.
- [2025-05-28] standup/dune/2025-05-28: Reminder: the scheduler deploys only on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC.
- [2025-08-08] standup/dune/2025-08-08: New deploy window for the job scheduler: on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays. Forget the previous Tuesdays 13:00-15:00 UTC slot. Observation from the Dune team: after the marketing send, billing-api's queue depth hit 50,000.
- [2026-01-14] standup/dune/2026-01-14: Reminder: Tomasz is on call for team Dune this cycle.
- [2025-05-02] standup/cinder/2025-05-02-2: The catalog deploy window: on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. Team Cinder holds planning on Mondays.
- [2025-10-02] standup/cinder/2025-10-02: On-call rotation: Yuki is primary for team Cinder starting today; Diego is off rotation.
- [2025-03-21] standup/ember/2025-03-21: The job scheduler can be released on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception.
- [2026-03-17] standup/cinder/2026-03-17: Reminder: notifier is owned by team Cinder.

- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09-3: Marcus is on call for the Boreal team to start the year.
- [2026-04-14] standup/atlas/2026-04-14: Marcus Oyelaran picked up the Atlas on-call shift from Priya today.
- [2025-11-12] standup/boreal/2025-11-12: The catalog service's deploy window changes today: it is now on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. The old slot (Mondays 10:00-12:00 UTC) is retired.
- [2025-08-12] standup/boreal/2025-08-12: Rotation day for the Boreal team: Marcus hands the pager to Lena Fischer.
